children: The initial public share offering of Nigeria's Dangote refinery will involve the sale of 4.1 bln shares at a price of between 500 naira ($0.3785) and 595 naira ($0.4504) per share, two sources with direct knowledge of the deal told Reuters on Friday.

One of the sources said the price being considered for the IPO was 525 naira per share. The 500-595 naira price range would allow Dangote to raise between $1.55 billion and $1.8 billion.    The order book for the offer is set to open on Sept. 14, the second source said. Dangote Refinery declined to comment.
